Each shape moves along an arrow path. The key is to identify which movement takes the **longest time**. This can be inferred by observing the **distance traveled** and the **sequence of frames** over which the movement occurs.

- **Yellow circle**: Moves from bottom-right toward orange triangle. This movement appears short in terms of frame duration.
- **Green triangle**: Moves from right toward blue circle. Also relatively short.
- **Blue circle**: Moves from top toward white circle. Shorter movement.

- **White circle**: Moves from the **middle** of the screen toward the **left** (toward the purple square). This is the **longest distance** among all movements.
